vulnerability_mechanism.detail: At tag 2.9.1, DraftsController#create permits the submitted post fields, forces status=draft_child and post_parent=params[:post_id], and saves without validation. For the documented request with post_id=2, the drafts scope includes that row and posts/index.html.erb renders PostDecorator#the_hierarchy_title; the helper concatenates the unescaped title and calls html_safe, so the stored img/onerror payload executes in the administrator's drafts listing. The live CVE.org record is PUBLISHED and describes this same low-privilege-to-admin stored-XSS path.

atomic_bic.detail: 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8 is the smallest public first-write of the executing sink: its focused diff adds the_hierarchy_title with res.html_safe and switches the listing to that helper. A reverse -S history through 2.9.1 finds that commit for the helper. The draft-storage source already existed in the 2015 root release, so it is not a later AI-marked commit substituted for the BIC.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: The BIC has immediate parent 0ee955225a517ea121ed5b3e8029e64fdae07719. That parent has no the_hierarchy_title and the listing passes f.the_title directly to link_to/ERB, leaving Rails to escape it; the vulnerable html_safe hierarchy sink is absent.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8 is a single-parent page-hierarchy feature commit with a directly verifiable parent and focused vulnerable hunks, not a merge, revert, or squash aggregate with reconstructable finer public members. Later commit 67787c2840e915ef4bfc8cdcbf7291165517fc82 only reformats the same helper for RuboCop and preserves res.html_safe, so its later blame attribution does not replace the BIC.

affected_release_membership.detail: The BIC is absent from 2.1.1, present from 2.1.2, and is an ancestor of affected tag 2.9.1. CVE-2026-73329 records CamaleonCMS versions through 2.9.1 as affected.

fixed_release_membership.detail: Fix e9e034e371719ebaec61d6283b312058a60efa6a is not an ancestor of 2.9.1 but is an ancestor of 2.9.2 and 2.9.3. The 2.9.2 changelog names PR #1143 and HTML escaping for post titles in admin views including the drafts list.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.detail: e9e034e371719ebaec61d6283b312058a60efa6a directly changes the_title from the unescaped translated title to h.h(...) and adds regression cases for img/onerror and script payloads. Because the_hierarchy_title consumes the_title before marking the assembled string html_safe, the advisory's title payload remains entity-escaped.

bic_only_ai_attribution.detail: AI attribution was evaluated only on BIC 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8. Its raw commit object records Owen <owenperedo@gmail.com> as author and committer on 2016-01-17, has one parent, and contains no Co-Authored-By, generated-with, Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable AI marker. Fix-side and later security activity was not used to attribute the BIC.

findings: The published advisory is real rather than withdrawn or rejected: CVE.org currently reports CVE-2026-73329 state=PUBLISHED and affected versions <=2.9.1.
The source-to-sink mechanism, atomic BIC 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8, and immediate parent 0ee955225a517ea121ed5b3e8029e64fdae07719 independently reproduce the primary record.
The release boundary independently reproduces: vulnerable BIC in 2.9.1, direct fix e9e034e371719ebaec61d6283b312058a60efa6a absent from 2.9.1 and present in 2.9.2+.
The BIC-only authorship evidence supports NOT_AI; no correction to the primary record is required.
